images.headline: Software and AI implementation
images.prompt:
Create ONE finished premium educational presentation image, landscape 16:9. Matched Data Science Masterminds Agentic Founder series. Apple-inspired restraint, generous negative space, deep evergreen #142823 background fading to near-black green, ivory-white text, restrained amber #F4B544 and muted teal details. Space Grotesk-like clean headings and Inter-like body. Large perfectly legible English, 6% safe margins. Friendly polished 3D objects with subtle studio lighting, no robots, no money imagery, no clutter. Footer exactly: left 'Data Science Masterminds', center 'Agentic Founder', right 'Kunaal Naik & Arpan Saxena'. Footer small but legible. No extra text beyond specified copy. Prices are hypothetical offers, never earnings.
Chapter index, text-led layout, minimal illustration. Eyebrow 'CHAPTER 20'. Headline 'Software and AI implementation'. Supporting sentence 'Consider this if you can engineer, test and support reliable software.'. List these five topics in five large spacious rows, exact IDs and titles:
AI-096  Custom GPT-to-plugin migration service
AI-097  Niche SaaS support integration
AI-098  AI workflow evaluation service
AI-099  Internal reporting plugin integration
AI-100  Single-workflow micro-SaaS
Decision line: 'Choose one problem. Test one paid offer.' Include exact footer. Avoid additional decorative text.
images.review_notes: Visually inspected: correct five index entries or correct migration offer, hypothesis price and permissions qualification; legible branding and no clipping.
